Solid lines and plain labels are **Confirmed**; dashed yellow nodes are **Proposed**; dashed red nodes are **Blocked/TODO**. Labels read `Pin <NanoKit pin> / GPIO<n>` so the physical NanoKit header pin and the ESP32 GPIO are always shown together. Every component declared in `nanokit.yaml` appears here, including those still blocked (18) or proposed (4), so the diagram never silently drops planned hardware.
